_readme.title: Vayu + VIB Integrator Roadmap
_readme.source: Roadmap supplied by the project owner; synchronized to the VIB/VIR execution plan
_readme.status_policy: Statuses reflect the supplied roadmap. Never mark a feature complete without repository and test evidence.

phase_status.next: Immediate next work; not yet complete.
phase_status.deferred: Intentionally deferred. Do not implement until the phase is explicitly unblocked.

architecture_notes: VIR is an in-memory internal representation, not a .vye package.
Early --native means Integrator-mediated execution of verified VIR, not native machine code. Do not claim machine-code generation until Phase 12 is implemented and tested.
.vye packaging and the unified existing Interpreter/VM dispatch plus artifact cache are deferred under Phase 2A/2B/2C.
The four existing native-path flags should report truthful capability-derived diagnostics through VIB Integrator.
Keep Markdown documentation files untouched when a phase specifies code comments or tests only.
_readme.notes: Immediate work is Phases 0 and 1. Phase 2 implements VIR in memory only. Phase 2A, 2B, and 2C are deferred.

phases.name: Baseline and subsystem ownership
phases.description: Establish a reproducible clean-build baseline, define subsystem ownership, and encode route capabilities before implementation expands.

subphases.name: Confirm the Visual Studio Community clean baseline (Rebuild → Build → run_all.ps1) reproduces; record the preconditions in script comments.
subphases.description: Output: preconditions embedded in tests/vib_baseline.ps1.

subphases.name: Codify subsystem ownership: identify files belonging to the frontend, typechecker, interpreter, VM, and VIB.
subphases.description: Output: vib::Feature enum covering all four routes and every language feature.

subphases.name: Encode the capability matrix in code as the single source of truth.
subphases.description: Output: static CapabilityInfo table in VIB/Integrator.cpp.

subphases.name: Curate fixtures with stable expected stdout for --run and --vm, and stable failure messages for the four native-path flags.
subphases.description: Output: fixture and expected-output list embedded in tests/vib_baseline.ps1.

phases.name: Integrator API and CLI diagnostics
phases.description: Make VIB the single owner of capability queries, backend diagnostics, IR dumping, and runtime emission messages.

subphases.name: Expand VIB/Integrator.{hpp,cpp} with Feature, SupportLevel, ErrorKind, Backend, and CapabilityInfo; extend CompileResult; add static queries; add dumpIR and emitRuntime as Integrator methods.
subphases.description: Output: Integrator API; compile() messages derived from the capability table.

subphases.name: Route NativeCompiler::compileAndRun, dumpIR, and writeRuntimeC messages through Integrator and remove hardcoded strings.
subphases.description: Output: NativeCompiler becomes a pure adapter.

subphases.name: Add --vib-status to vayuc and route all four native-path flags through Integrator.
subphases.description: Output: new CLI flag and capability-derived diagnostics.

subphases.name: Build the Phase 0/1 harness.
subphases.description: Output: tests/vib_baseline.ps1.

phases.name: VIB internal representation (VIR)
phases.description: Build an in-memory-only intermediate representation for the supported subset. No .vye package and no artifact cache in this phase.

subphases.name: Create VIB VIR as the target IR produced by lowering and consumed by the verifier.
subphases.description: Output: VIB/Vir.{hpp,cpp} or equivalent; Feature::VIR = Supported for the implemented subset; --dump-ir prints real VIR.

phases.name: Values, arithmetic, and VIR execution
phases.description: Specify core value semantics, lower the first supported subset into VIR, and execute it with a minimal Integrator-owned in-memory VIR executor.

subphases.name: Specify integer, boolean, and None semantics, including overflow, conversion, division by zero, and comparison.
subphases.description: Output: semantics captured in code comments and tests; Feature::BasicArithmetic = Supported.

subphases.name: Lower integer/boolean expressions and local variables into VIR. Execute with a new minimal in-memory interpreter-of-VIR, not the existing tree-walker or existing VM.
subphases.description: Output: --native on a curated arithmetic fixture produces correct stdout through Integrator-mediated VIR execution. This is not native machine code; --native means Integrator-mediated execution at this stage.

subphases.name: Add a VIR verifier pass covering types, arity, and control-flow well-formedness.
subphases.description: Output: malformed-VIR rejection tests pass.

phases.name: String semantics and operations
phases.description: Define stable string behavior and lower string operations into VIR.

subphases.name: Define UTF-8 policy, representation, equality, concatenation, length, and index bounds.
subphases.description: Output: Feature::Strings = Supported after semantics and conformance tests are complete.

subphases.name: Lower string constants and operations into VIR.
subphases.description: Output: string fixtures pass under --native using Integrator-mediated VIR execution.

phases.name: Functions and calls
phases.description: Implement function execution and explicit call-frame semantics in VIR.

subphases.name: Implement functions, parameters, return values, local scopes, direct calls, and arity/type checks in VIR.
subphases.description: Output: Feature::Functions = Supported.

subphases.name: Implement recursion only after stack-frame safety is proven.
subphases.description: Output: recursion fixtures pass.

phases.name: Control flow and verification
phases.description: Implement structured control flow and strengthen verifier diagnostics.

subphases.name: Implement conditional branches, loops, and return, break, and continue semantics in VIR.
subphases.description: Output: Feature::ControlFlow = Supported.

subphases.name: Validate branch targets and diagnose unreachable code in the verifier.
subphases.description: Output: invalid-branch rejection tests pass.

phases.name: Collections
phases.description: Implement collection representations and operations incrementally, gated by conformance tests.

subphases.name: Implement list in VIR, including representation, indexing, mutation, iteration, and ownership.
subphases.description: Output: Collections reports list = Supported.

subphases.name: Implement map, tuple, and set, each gated by conformance tests.
subphases.description: Output: remaining collection fixtures pass.

phases.name: Modules and multi-file builds
phases.description: Resolve module identity and dependencies and make builds reproducible.

subphases.name: Implement module identity, import resolution, and dependency validation in VIR.
subphases.description: Output: Feature::Modules = Supported.

subphases.name: Build multi-file programs reproducibly from declared inputs.
subphases.description: Output: multi-file fixture passes.

phases.name: VIR malformed-input verification and runtime compatibility
phases.description: Harden the VIR verifier and define compatibility policy in code.

subphases.name: Test malformed VIR including huge counts, invalid indices, truncated structures, bad strings, and stack exhaustion.
subphases.description: Output: malformed-input tests pass.

subphases.name: Define runtime-compatibility policy in code, without a Markdown file, and expose it through --vib-status --json.
subphases.description: Output: machine-readable runtime compatibility policy.

phases.name: Advanced language features and system APIs
phases.description: Expand the supported language subset one independently tested group at a time.

subphases.name: Implement exceptions, classes/objects, closures, higher-order functions, generators, and pointers as separate tested groups.
subphases.description: Output: each feature changes status independently in --vib-status.

subphases.name: Implement system APIs and the standard-library surface relevant to the Integrator subset.
subphases.description: Output: parity with the Interpreter for the supported subset.

phases.name: Deferred .vye packaging design and writer
phases.description: Package work is intentionally deferred. Do not implement a writer until explicitly unblocked.

subphases.name: Design-only .vye container specification: magic, version, section table, entry point, deterministic serialization, and compatibility policy.
subphases.description: Output: design captured in code comments and API shape only, with no writer; Feature::VyePackaging = Scaffolded.

subphases.name: Implement deterministic .vye writer gated by --emit-vye <path>.
subphases.description: Output: --emit-vye writes a package only when this deferred phase is authorized and its gate is reached.

phases.name: Deferred .vye reader and execution
phases.description: Strict package loading and the package execution verb remain deferred.

subphases.name: Implement a strict .vye reader and verifier.
subphases.description: Output: reader passes malformed-package tests.

subphases.name: Add vayu run <file>.vye execution.
subphases.description: Output: round-trip and execution tests pass.

phases.name: Deferred unified backend dispatch and artifact cache
phases.description: Unifying existing Interpreter/VM dispatch and introducing persistent caching are deferred until explicitly authorized.

subphases.name: Make Integrator the dispatch owner for the Interpreter backend: --run calls Integrator::dispatch(Backend::Interpreter, ...), with behavior unchanged.
subphases.description: Output: run_all.ps1 remains green and dispatch is unified.

subphases.name: Make Integrator the dispatch owner for the VM backend: --vm calls Integrator::dispatch(Backend::VM, ...), with behavior unchanged.
subphases.description: Output: run_all.ps1 remains green.

subphases.name: Adopt a content-addressed, atomic, recoverable artifact cache and incremental graph matching clean-build output.
subphases.description: Output: cache and incremental-equivalence tests pass.

phases.name: Benchmarks and performance tuning
phases.description: Measure real behavior before optimizing and make no unsupported performance claims.

subphases.name: Measure compile time, startup, steady-state execution, memory, and package size as separate metrics.
subphases.description: Output: reproducible measurements.

subphases.name: Tune performance based on measurements and regression tests.
subphases.description: Output: benchmark evidence supports any performance claims.

phases.name: Native code generation
phases.description: Research and implement actual native code generation on top of verified VIR, with target and ABI rules owned by Vayu.

subphases.name: Research and implement native code generation on VIR; keep target/ABI rules in Vayu-owned code and do not bundle LLD, DLLs, import libraries, or an external backend.
subphases.description: Output: native artifacts pass conformance for each supported target.

subphases.name: Report NativeCodegen = Supported in --vib-status only for targets proven by tests.
subphases.description: Output: honest capability status changes only after target conformance passes.

phases.name: Vayu-owned ONNX support
phases.description: Implement an independent ONNX reader and small operator runtime without a Python generator.

subphases.name: Implement a Vayu-owned ONNX parser/reader and native fixtures; do not use a Python generator.
subphases.description: Output: malformed-model and numerical-correctness tests pass.

subphases.name: Implement a small operator subset first and expand through tests.
subphases.description: Output: per-operator support in --vib-status.

phases.name: Capability reporting and self-hosting
phases.description: Expose the supported feature/runtime matrix and begin bootstrap work only after the Integrator subset is stable.

subphases.name: Publish the supported feature/runtime-version matrix at runtime through --vib-status --json.
subphases.description: Output: machine-readable capability matrix.

subphases.name: Start the self-hosting bootstrap loop only after the Integrator subset is stable.
subphases.description: Output: fixpoint reproduced by run_all.ps1 -FixpointOnly.
